summary: 56-year-old woman took a reported 65-foot tumbling, sliding fall on the snowfield between Chasm Junction and Chasm Lake; the park Search and Rescue team reached her within two hours, performed a technical litter raise to the trail, carried her to Chasm Meadows, and Flight for Life flew her to a Lakewood hospital with numerous injuries.
location: Snowfield between Chasm Junction and Chasm Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue team
notes: INSERT run1006; NPS release dated 2014-06-16: incident Sunday June 15, 2014 (weekday-verified); release image caption "June 15 2013" is a filename typo (2013-06-15 was a Saturday). County Boulder per id-2463 Mills Glacier/Chasm Lake precedent.
